impact.text: Alice's funds associated with the withdrawal request in epoch `E` are permanently locked and cannot be retrieved via the standard contract functions.

precondition_sources.text: A user has a pending withdrawal request in an active withdrawal epoch E.

intent_sources.text: A user's pending withdrawal request in an epoch must remain retrievable via standard contract functions (executeWithdrawal or cancelWithdrawal) rather than becoming permanently locked.
